products.name: Seafood Receiving Evidence Desk
products.product: A focused seafood receiving and lot evidence workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small seafood processors, wholesalers, and dock-to-market teams
products.problem: Supplier, harvest or source records, arrival condition, temperature evidence, quantity, lot identity, acceptance, and storage placement can be split across paper and ERP entries.
products.valueProposition: Turns seafood receiving and lot evidence into a visible operating queue so every received lot has the processor-required source, condition, identity, quantity, disposition, and storage evidence.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets seafood receiving and lot evidence software, seafood receiving and lot evidence tracker, seafood receiving and lot evidence template, and seafood receiving and lot evidence checklist searches.

products.name: Customer Specification Release
products.product: A focused seafood customer specification and order release workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small seafood processors, wholesalers, and dock-to-market teams
products.problem: Species, cut, size, pack, label, source claim, substitution, price, and ship timing vary by account and order.
products.valueProposition: Turns seafood customer specification and order release into a visible operating queue so every production order is released against the current approved customer specification and substitution decision.
products.topic: seafood customer specification and order release
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets seafood customer specification and order release software, seafood customer specification and order release tracker, seafood customer specification and order release template, and seafood customer specification and order release checklist searches.

products.name: Cold Storage Pick Check
products.product: A focused seafood cold storage order picking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small seafood processors, wholesalers, and dock-to-market teams
products.problem: Lot rotation, holds, customer allocation, case counts, partials, location moves, and shipment staging create high-cost picking exceptions.
products.valueProposition: Turns seafood cold storage order picking into a visible operating queue so every staged seafood order has the correct released lot, quantity, location, and customer allocation independently checked.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets seafood cold storage order picking software, seafood cold storage order picking tracker, seafood cold storage order picking template, and seafood cold storage order picking checklist searches.
